summary: Clear Secure, Inc. (filer) disclosed on Form 8-K that its subsidiary Alclear Holdings, LLC amended its credit agreement as of June 23, 2026. The amendment reduces lender commitments from $100M to $50M, increases the letter of credit sublimit from $35M to $50M, lowers the applicable margin (to 1.50% for term SOFR loans and 0.50% for base rate loans), reduces the unused commitment fee from 0.35% to 0.25%, and extends the maturity date from June 28, 2026 to June 23, 2031. This is a routine financing renegotiation, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
